info.title: Blade & Soul
info.synopsis: Una pace durata ben 1000 anni giunge alla sua fine quando il neonato Wind Empire decide di conquistare lo Stratus Empire, con lo scopo di unificare 4 continenti, all'insegna di una nuova era di uguaglianza, anche se quest'era dovesse essere imposta attraverso le armi. E' in questo clima già  difficile che compaiono delle entità  chiamate Darksiders, inivocate dall'infame Jin Seoyeon, uomo dalle ambizioni smisurate. Chi, in questo clima di guerra, riuscirà  ad opporsi al male ed a salvare il mondo?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Alka is chased by the Empire, and runs into Koga, who notices her skill with the blade. She's taken to their village. The village's land is great for cultivating Heaven's Spirits, so the Empire wants their land. Morii hires Alka as a bodyguard. Jin Varrel commands the Flower Monks and searches for Alka, saying she killed her master.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Wanted posters are posted in the red light district of this town of Alka. Jin Hazuki, the bounty hunter, takes Alka to the Tomon Inn. They meet the proprietress, Elle Karen. Karen realizes she's the bounty, but has a policy of leaving business outside of her establishment.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Alka and Hazuki continue to fight and run into the Pleasure Gang. Dan Loana, the leader of the gang, tells Alka that she's trying to take revenge against Jin. She tries to explain that revenge is about an emotion, not a rule, and uses Alka as bait to lure Jin in.
